items.title: 10.17 E standard qeematon ke istemalat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.17 heading, printed page 231.

blocks.text: Standard electrode potentials cell mein electron flow ki simt nikalne (10.17.1), redox reaction ke mumkin (feasible) hone ka andaza lagane (10.17.2), aur oxidising aur reducing agents ki taqat ka muqabla karne (10.17.3) mein istemal hote hain. Agle teen topics har istemal bayan karte hain.

blocks.prompt: Is chapter mein E standard qeematon ke teen istemal batayein.
blocks.explanation: Bairooni circuit mein electron flow ki simt dhundna, E cell ke nishan se kisi tajweez shuda redox reaction ke mumkin hone ka faisla, aur species ko un ki E standard qeematon ke musbat ya manfi hone se oxidising ya reducing agents ke taur par tarteeb dena.

items: E standard ke istemalat: electron flow ki simt; reaction ki feasibility; oxidising aur reducing agents ki nisbati taqat.
